messages:
Anna L: Heads-up — noticed a token-latency bump on the long-context routes after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Looks correlated with a drop in prefix-cache reuse. 
Kevin M: Interesting — which metric shows the drop?
Anna L: Prefix-cache reuse rate (route label) fell from ~78% -> ~41% for /chat/long-context between 03:10-03:40 UTC. Evictions spiked. Token p50 went from 22ms -> 37ms. See snippet from grafana query: 
```
# prometheus-ish
sum by (route) (increase(kv_prefix_reuse_total[30m])) / sum by (route) (increase(kv_prefix_lookups_total[30m]))
```
Maria S: perf-bot shows deploy @1958472120 (kernel-selector v2) rolled at 03:05. perf-bot: deploy succeeded :white_check_mark: 
perf-bot: kernel-selector:v2 rolled to runtimepool/region-a at 03:05 UTC.
Sam T: Any changes to shard mapping or cache key normalization in that change? Could affect prefix grouping.
Kevin M: The change added a new heuristic to pick kernels based on avg_seq_len histogram. No direct key normalization touch, but we did add a small alignment to sequence tiling which could change KV fingerprinting for some routes.
Anna L: I pulled a sampling of traces — in affected requests the KV lookup key length differs by 1-2 tokens after kernel selection path changes, causing a different prefix key and miss. Example trace snippet: 
```
KV.lookup(prefix_key=\"user:abc:prefix:chunk-12\") -> miss
KV.lookup(prefix_key=\"user:abc:prefix:chunk-11\") -> hit
```
Kevin M: That would explain increased evictions and less reuse. Can we reproduce locally with the new kernel logic + a long-context replay?
Sam T: I ran a 5k request replay against the staging image earlier — saw reuse drop ~30% only on sequences > 4096. I can share the flamegraph for KV path; shows a spike in `compute_prefix_hash` time due to extra tiling step.
Maria S: From alerting POV, eviction_rate > 10/min combined with p50 token latency > 30ms for >2m should page. We didn't have an alert for reuse rate. We should add a per-route reuse-rate SLO/alert.
Anna L: Proposal: 1) add per-route metric `kv_prefix_reuse_ratio{route}` exported from runtime 2) add a grafana panel token-latency-by-kv-hit (split p50/p95 by kv_hit=true/false) 3) instrument `kernel_selector.choice` label so we can roll-forward/roll-back by choice 4) immediate mitigation: toggle kernel-selector v2 flag for region-a until we fix key alignment.
Kevin M: I can add the `kv_prefix_reuse_ratio` and `kernel_selector.choice` label in runtime exporter. Suggested prometheus exposition: 
```
# gauge per scrape
kv_prefix_reuse_ratio{route=\"$route\"} %
kernel_selector_choice{pool=\"$pool\",choice=\"v2\"} 1
```
Sam T: I'll produce a diff with the replay and share the profiling artifacts (heap + kv metrics) in the thread. Helps decide whether patch or revert is faster.
Maria S: I'll create dashboard panels and an alert rule draft. For dashboard, suggest panels: 
- Prefix reuse heatmap (route x shard)
- Eviction rate (per-shard)
- Memory footprint by prefix-shard
- Token latency split by kv_hit label
- Kernel-choice adoption over time

Anna L: Action owners: Kevin -> export labels/metrics (ETA 6h). Sam -> replay + profiling (ETA 3h). Maria -> dashboard + alert PR (ETA 4h). I'll open an incident ticket and coordinate rollback plan if needed.
Kevin M: If we end up rolling back, we should gate kernel-selector changes behind a feature flag per-pool. I'll add that as part of the change.
perf-bot: rollback suggestion recorded: recommend feature-flagging large-seq kernel selection for 24h to observe reuse delta.
Anna L: OK thanks team. @Kevin M please post the exact metric names when you add them so Maria can wire dashboards. :thumbsup:
Kevin M: Will do — posting names when exporter PR is up.
Anna L: Closing loop — will update incident ticket with dashboards + next steps after PRs land. :eyes:
